subject: Emotions
title: Elevation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Elevation.

hook.text: You watch a stranger help an elderly person cross the street and feel a warm, tingling sensation in your chest.

buildup.text: Jonathan Haidt named this 'elevation'—joy triggered by witnessing moral beauty or acts of human goodness.

discovery.text: Elevation releases oxytocin and activates the vagus nerve. Your body physically responds to seeing goodness.

twist.text: Elevation is contagious. Watching others do good makes you more likely to do good yourself. Virtue spreads.

climax.text: This may explain why inspiring stories go viral. The brain rewards sharing moral beauty with a chemical high.

punchline.text: Seeing good people do good things makes you better.

quiz.question: Who coined the term 'elevation' for moral joy?
